instruction: Set the minimum chunk size threshold to 200000 bytes for IMAP operations.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing min chunk size threshold from 159744 to 200000 bytes. The evaluator checks if mail.imap.min_chunk_size_threshold is set to 200000. Original profile has min_chunk_size_threshold=159744, so this requires modification. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_file fetches the correct Thunderbird prefs.js file from the VM
Metric logic is correct: check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and checks if mail.imap.min_chunk_size_threshold equals 200000
Data flow is correct: prefs.js contains IMAP settings, metric extracts and compares the correct preference key
Expected value is correct: 200000 bytes matches the instruction requirement
Postconfig is appropriate: closes Thunderbird window before verification to ensure prefs.js is saved
Complete coverage: the single requirement in the instruction is fully verified
Edge case handling: metric returns 0.0 if result file is None
